name: OpenViking
ontology_notes: Three context types: Resource, Memory, Skill. Built-in memory files are profile.md, preferences/, entities/, events/, identity.md, soul.md, cases/, trajectories/, experiences/. Peer memories live under viking://user/{user_id}/peers/{peer_id}/memories/. L0/L1/L2 layered files. This is an agent context filesystem, not companion role tables, but identity and soul are first-class assistant persona files.

ontology.evidence: docs/en/concepts/02-context-types.md (repo) tables Resource vs Memory vs Skill and the built-in memory types including identity.md and soul.md. Peer path is viking://user/{user_id}/peers/{peer_id}/memories/. Custom templates can extend types.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Resources are user-added. Memories are agent-extracted on session.commit() (08-session.md). add_message can take peer_id. Extraction policy writes candidate memories then persists a memory_diff.json. Skills are user or system added. No intimate-text refusal.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: 07-retrieval.md: find() is single-query hierarchical retrieval without session. search() runs LLM intent analysis into 0-5 TypedQueries then rerank. Unified find across memories/resources/skills. Returning zero hits is allowed. Agents also read identity.md and soul.md as files.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: session.md: memory_diff.json records all memory changes from a commit for audit and rollback. Snapshots API exists (llms.txt). Freshness-aware parent bubbling is a design doc. Not Graphiti-style invalid_at on every fact.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Sessions archive with timestamps. Events memory type stores decisions and milestones. Retrieval uses freshness in design docs. No documented last-Tuesday fact query API in 07-retrieval.md.
temporal.label: inferred

identity_split.evidence: User space vs agent space vs peer space. identity.md and soul.md are the assistant. profile.md is the user. A Peer is a stable other, not a typed relationship. Coding-agent skills/trajectories dominate. Not user vs character vs relationship as companion kinds.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: find/search rank memories for the task. No social skip. Privacy configs (13-privacy.md) redact skill secrets, not trauma recall.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: 13-privacy.md extracts api_key/token from SKILL.md into versioned privacy configs. ACL and multi-tenant APIs exist. memory_diff.json is an audit log. Retrieved memory files are still prompt text without trust tags.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: Snapshots and memory_diff rollback. OVPack import/export. No documented user forget-that that hides a fact from the next find() without a manual file edit.
forgetting.label: inferred

cost_shape.evidence: commit() archives sync then LLM-extracts memories async. search() adds an LLM query planner (0-5 TypedQueries) plus embeddings and rerank. find() skips the planner. Resource ingest parses without LLM then generates L0/L1 async. README LoCoMo token drop 34.3-91.0%.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: AGPL-3.0 LICENSE (not Apache, despite the docs footer). Self-host server and CLI are first-class. Local embedding llama.cpp design exists. AGPL copyleft applies if you network-serve a modified binary. Volcengine hosted option exists.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Official MCP clients guide (en/agent-integrations/06-mcp-clients) and OAuth 2.1 MCP design. Also first-party plugins for Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Cursor, DeepSeek Harness.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: identity.md, soul.md, profile.md, and peer memory folders are closer to companion split than a flat Graph-RAG. The product is still a coding-agent context database. Retrieval injects files into the agent. No silence. License is AGPL-3.0.

published_eval.name: LoCoMo, tau2-bench
published_eval.claimed_score: README: with OpenViking, OpenClaw/Hermes/Claude Code LoCoMo accuracy 80-83% (from 24-57% native). tau2-bench Retail 77.81% vs 70.94%, Airline 66.25% vs 54.38%. Token drop 34.3-91.0%.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Long-conversation user-memory fact QA (LoCoMo) and multi-turn tool-agent tasks (tau2). Not character drift or social silence.

open_unknowns: Whether peer memory is enabled by default or only when the memory policy permits it.
Exact extract LLM calls per session.commit().
